title: About Bloom — founded in 2025 across Oman, Italy and China
meta_description: Three teaching practices that merged and moved to Bengaluru. Meet Meriam Friaa and the former examiners who teach every part of the exam.

props.heading: Founded because good students kept failing for bad reasons.
props.body:
Bloom started in 2025 as three separate teaching practices — one in Muscat, one in Milan, one in Shanghai — each run by former IELTS examiners who had spent years watching capable candidates lose marks on things nobody had ever told them about: a missing article, a date written the wrong way, thirty seconds of silence in Part 2.

The three merged that same year and moved operations to Bengaluru. Across 2,840 students the method has not changed. Test honestly. Teach the specific thing. Mark it against the real criteria. Repeat until the number moves.

items.title: An honest level beats a flattering one
items.body: A placement test that tells you what you want to hear produces a study plan that wastes your time.

items.title: Practice without feedback is not practice
items.body: It is the single biggest waste of preparation time we see, and it is why most self-study plateaus.

items.title: Your first language predicts your errors
items.body: Not your ability. Targeting interference patterns is faster than general grammar revision.

items.title: Consistency beats intensity
items.body: Twenty focused minutes a day beats four hours on a Sunday. The streak is the best predictor we have.

items.title: We will tell you if you are not ready
items.body: Sitting the test too early costs money and confidence. We would rather lose the entry fee than your trust.

props.heading: The people who make the academy run.
props.lead: One operational leader, three former examiners and four specialists. Every teacher marks a single part of the exam for a living.

staff.name: Meriam Friaa
staff.bio: Runs everything that is not a lesson — admissions, timetabling, teacher allocation, exam entries and the FMA Overseas partnership. Rebuilt the academy around measurement rather than goodwill; retention went from 71% to 94%.

staff.name: Dr. Sarah Whitfield
staff.role: Former IELTS Examiner · Listening & Reading Lead
staff.bio: Fourteen years marking IELTS Listening and Reading. Specialises in students who understand the content but lose marks on transfer and timing.

staff.name: Dr. Elena Marchetti
staff.bio: Trains IELTS writing examiners. Marks your essay against the official descriptors line by line, then rewrites one paragraph with you so you can see the difference.

staff.name: Michael Chen
staff.bio: Full mock interviews under exam conditions with immediate criterion-by-criterion feedback. Particularly strong on pronunciation for Mandarin, Cantonese and Vietnamese speakers.

staff.name: James Okonkwo
staff.bio: Reading strategy specialist. If you understand the passages but never finish the paper, this is the teacher to book.

staff.name: Anjali Prasad
staff.bio: Works almost exclusively with Hindi, Urdu, Bengali and Tamil speakers. Targets articles, tense consistency and the direct-translation habits that cap students at Band 6.

staff.name: Dr. Hana Al-Balushi
staff.bio: Leads the medical track for doctors, nurses and dentists sitting OET or the IELTS 7.0-each requirement for GMC, NMC and DHA registration.

staff.name: Li Wei
staff.bio: Focuses on the obstacles specific to Mandarin and Cantonese speakers: final consonants, plural and past-tense endings, and extending answers past one sentence.
